title: Extract all numbers from text
search_queries: python regex extract all numbers from string

text.description: Input text from which numbers are extracted

numbers.description: List of numbers found in the text, in order of appearance

assumptions: Numbers include integers and decimals, optionally with leading sign (+/-).
Numbers may be embedded in words or separated by punctuation.
Scientific notation (e.g., 1e5) is not considered a number.
Commas as thousand separators are not supported; '1,000' is treated as two numbers: 1 and 000.
The output numbers are converted to Python int or float as appropriate.
Overlapping matches are not possible; regex scans left to right.
limitations: Does not handle numbers in scientific notation.
Does not handle numbers with thousand separators.
Does not handle fractions or mixed numbers.
Does not handle numbers written in words.
Only processes plain text; no HTML or markup stripping.
No locale-specific decimal separators (e.g., comma as decimal point).

input.text: The price is 12.5 dollars and 3 items.
